items.question: How do I sign up?
items.answer: Creating an account is free and easy. Click 'Sign Up' on the homepage, enter your name, email, and a secure password. Verify your phone number to activate your account, agree to the Terms of Service, and you're ready to go!

items.question: How do I make my first spot request?
items.answer: After signing up, go to your Dashboard and click 'I Need a Spot'. Drop a pin on the map where you want to park, set your arrival time and vehicle type. The system will search for available matches in real-time.

items.question: Is there a free trial?
items.answer: The first 100 users receive a free 1-year premium membership. After that, we offer a standard plan at $4.99/month with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

items.question: Do I need to verify my phone?
items.answer: Yes, phone verification is required to ensure all members are real and to prevent spam. You'll receive a one-time SMS code during signup.

items.question: How do I drop a pin on a parking spot?
items.answer: In the Dashboard, select 'I Need a Spot' or 'I'm Leaving a Spot'. The map will center on your current location. Tap or click the exact street location where you want to park. A red pin will appear to confirm your selection.

items.question: Can I set my arrival and departure times?
items.answer: Yes, you can set both arrival looking time and departure time. Our matching algorithm uses these times to find compatible members. You can adjust them anytime before a match is confirmed.

items.question: What vehicle types are supported?
items.answer: We support small cars, standard sedans, and large vehicles (SUVs, trucks). Select your vehicle type in your profile settings to ensure spot compatibility.

items.question: How accurate does the pin need to be?
items.answer: Drop the pin as close to the actual parking spot as possible. The map uses high-resolution street data. Zoom in for better accuracy. A 5-10 meter precision is sufficient for successful matching.

items.question: How does the matching algorithm work?
items.answer: Our algorithm matches departing users (leaving a spot) with arriving users (looking for a spot) based on location proximity, time overlap (within a 15-minute tolerance window), vehicle compatibility, and member ratings.

items.question: How long does matching take?
items.answer: Matching is nearly instant during peak hours when many members are active. During slower periods, it may take a few minutes. You'll see a 'Searching...' indicator while the system looks for compatible matches.

items.question: Can I decline a match?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel a match if the timing or location doesn't work for you. However, frequent cancellations may affect your ranking score, so only request spots you genuinely need.

items.question: What happens when both members confirm?
items.answer: Once both members confirm the match, the exchange enters the 'Confirmed' state. You'll be redirected to the live tracking page where you can see the other member's approach in real-time.

items.question: How does the Uber-style tracking work?
items.answer: Once a match is confirmed, the arriving user shares their live GPS location. The departing user sees their approach on a map with an estimated time of arrival (ETA). This works like ride-sharing tracking.

items.question: What is the geofence safety feature?
items.answer: Our geofence creates a 75-meter virtual boundary around the parking spot. The departing user cannot start their car until the arriving user is confirmed inside this geofence area. This prevents spot camping and ensures a fair exchange.

items.question: What is the exchange flow?
items.answer: The flow has 4 states: (1) Matched – both users confirmed, tracking active; (2) Arrived – arriving user is within the geofence; (3) Departing – departing user confirms departure; (4) Complete – exchange finished and the arriving user can park.

items.question: What if the other member doesn't show up?
items.answer: If a member doesn't arrive within a reasonable time, you can cancel the match. The system tracks no-shows, and repeat offenders may have their accounts suspended. We recommend communicating through the app.

items.question: How much does Spotimization cost?
items.answer: The standard plan is $4.99/month. We also offer an annual plan at a discounted rate. The first 100 users receive a free 1-year membership as part of our early adopter program.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover) and debit cards. Payments are processed securely through Stripe, our payment processor.

items.question: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
items.answer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your Account Settings. Your premium features will remain active until the end of your billing period.

items.question: Is there a refund policy?
items.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied, refunds are handled on a case-by-case basis within 30 days of your first payment.

items.question: How do I update my profile?
items.answer: Go to Profile from the Dashboard menu. You can update your name, email, neighborhood, and notification preferences. Changes are saved instantly.

items.question: How do notification settings work?
items.answer: You can enable or disable push notifications, email notifications, and alarm settings from your Profile page. We recommend keeping notifications on during active matches to receive real-time updates.

items.question: Can I manage my vehicle info?
items.answer: Vehicle information can be added in your Profile settings. You can set your vehicle type (car, motorcycle, bike, truck) and preferred spot size for better matching compatibility.

items.question: How are users verified?
items.answer: All users must verify their phone number and agree to our Terms of Service. We also track member ratings and match history to build a trusted community.

items.question: How does the rating system work?
items.answer: After each exchange, both members rate each other on a 5-star scale. Your overall rating is the average of all ratings received. Higher-rated members are prioritized in the matching algorithm.

items.question: How do I report a problem with another user?
items.answer: If there's an issue with another member, you can report it directly from a match card. Select 'Report Issue' and provide details. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

items.question: Is my personal information safe?
items.answer: Yes. We never share your personal information with other members without your consent. All communications are anonymized through the app. Your payment data is processed securely through Stripe.

items.question: Why is my GPS not working?
items.answer: Check that Location Services are enabled for Spotimization in your device settings. Enable 'High Accuracy' mode for best results. If issues persist, try restarting the app or your device.

items.question: Why is the map not loading?
items.answer: Verify your internet connection is working. Try clearing the app cache from your device settings. If the problem continues, update to the latest version or reinstall the app.

items.question: I found a bug. How do I report it?
items.answer: Describe the bug with steps to reproduce it and a screenshot if possible. Reports are reviewed regularly by the development team.

items.question: Why am I not receiving notifications?
items.answer: Ensure notifications are enabled for Spotimization in your device settings. Check that your phone isn't in Do Not Disturb mode. Enable Background App Refresh for reliable notification delivery.
